## Notes

Must be level 130 crafter and complete previous quests from the Shipwrecked timeline to get this quest.

## Steps

1. Harvest 250 resources from Scars of Destruction zones ([[Sodden Archipelago]]/[[Western Wastes]])
1. Return to Rakira

## Rewards

- At least 4p 30g 76s 84c
- [[Swampprowler Plushie]]
- [[Scars of Destruction Amalgamation]]
